enterCells: Enter the changing cells, such as B1:B3
enterName: Enter a name for the scenario
nameTaken: A scenario with that name already exists
nameTooLong: A scenario name can be up to 255 characters
noNewSheet: The workbook would not take a new sheet
none: There are no scenarios on this sheet
protected: This scenario is protected: unprotect the sheet to change it
tooManyCells: A scenario can change up to {max} cells
